subject: Yahoo
title: Yahoo Said No to Microsoft's {fact1}
description:
Why would Yahoo say no to Microsoft?
In 2008 Microsoft offered to buy Yahoo; Yahoo's board turned it down, and years later Verizon bought its core business.
Sources: Microsoft, CNBC (Jun 2017).
Based on public records and reporting. Not financial or legal advice.
